ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at lateral extremities and scattered linearly across both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous region covering approximately 95% of the fluke area; high-contrast geometric white clusters located at the distal tips; multiple high-contrast white linear segments of varying lengths and orientations distributed across the surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with sharply defined interior boundaries and a clear vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with frequent, high-amplitude peaks and valleys, exhibiting higher serration frequency towards the distal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature extending from the central notch to the pointed lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel blobs at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered minor circular anomalies visible on the central fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear disruptions; prominent diagonal white marks on the right lobe and vertical/oblique clusters on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the entire visible surface and heavy terminal scarring/weathering at the lobe tips.
